measurement.angle_convention: PCA major axis: atan2(-dy, dx) modulo 180 degrees; horizontal=0, vertical=90, '/' below 90, backslash above 90. Not individual pen-stroke angles.
measurement.density_denominator: native advance * 17; not padded canvas area
measurement.limits: Connected ink components are not pen strokes. A PCA axis can conceal crossings, hooks or isotropic shapes. Original x=0 / 17px-high measurement canvas may clip overhangs; this is a pinned measurement profile, not an all-font glyph law.

families.title: Parallel slant bundles
families.note: Compare complete three-mark shapes and native advance; do not fit each bundle as one diagonal.

families.title: Paired slant marks
families.note: Compare spacing, occupied height and inclination, not just component count.

families.title: Vertical / curved bundles
families.note: Compare the complete neighboring strokes and their bends; matching total ink alone is insufficient.

families.title: Narrow / fullwidth stems and punctuation
families.note: Equal advance does not mean equal height or ink. Fullwidth ｜ has a different placement footprint.

families.title: Forks and side strokes
families.note: Whole-glyph proposals for cooperating marks, not proof of any contact, split ownership or subject meaning.

families.title: Crossed ink shapes
families.note: A connected component may contain several crossing strokes. Its PCA axis does not describe all those strokes.

families.title: Dotted turn bundles
families.note: Compare dot positions and the longer return together; similar counts do not make these interchangeable.

families.title: Horizontal band bundles
families.note: Compare native width, inter-line spacing and occupied height, not density alone.

families.title: Short diagonals and dotted variants
families.note: Additional dots are part of the intact glyph, not decoration that can be removed independently.

families.title: Slope and native-width alternatives
families.note: Compare actual slope and width in this pinned font; codepoint names do not supply the angle.

families.title: Tone-band combination proposals
families.note: Strings supplied in the operator's review-target account; these repeated-row layouts are comparison proposals, not validated placement or value rules.

families.title: Curved crease / return proposals
families.note: Compare complete local return alternatives; quoted target spellings are not approved source-native passages or a runtime fix.
